about: [O7 critic] the bounty as a player: the board, the first man; does he answer anything (idle by him 15 s, then close 5 s, fists, the gun drawn, shots)?

steps.eval: (window.__toBoard = () => { const B = G.night.bounty.board(); G.stage.part('stream').warmAround(B.standX, B.standZ); N.controller.setPose(B.standX + B.nx * 0.4, B.standZ + B.nz * 0.4, Math.atan2(B.nx, B.nz), 0); return [B.x, B.z]; }, window.__toBoard())

(() => { const b = G.night.bounty.names()[0]; window.__b = b; G.stage.part('stream').warmAround(b.x, b.z); const g = G.night.graph(); let px = b.x + 9, pz = b.z; for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) { const a = i * Math.PI / 8, q = new N.THREE.Vector3(b.x + Math.cos(a) * 9, 0, b.z + Math.sin(a) * 9); const q0 = q.clone(); G.stage.colliders.resolve(q, 0.4); if (q.distanceTo(q0) < 0.05 && g.lineOfSight(q.x, q.z, b.x, b.z) && !G.stage.part('city').C.inWater(q.x, q.z)) { px = q.x; pz = q.z; break; } } N.controller.setPose(px, pz, Math.atan2(-(b.x - px), -(b.z - pz)), -0.02); G.stage.part('bounds').navAround(px, pz, 20); return [b.name, b.district, b.x, b.z]; })()

(()=>{const h=G.night.bounty.men.get('b0');if(!h)return 'none';const p=N.controller.pos;return 'man d '+Math.hypot(h.pos?h.pos.x-p.x:h.root.position.x-p.x,(h.pos?h.pos.z:h.root.position.z)-p.z).toFixed(1)+' alive '+h.alive+' state '+h.state+' hp '+h.health+' brawl '+!!(G.fight||G.brawl&&G.brawl.active)+' heat '+G.police.heat+' line '+G.hud.kit.objectiveText+' hp me '+(G.player.health&&G.player.health.hp)})()
